input.quote: However, any Party may terminate its participation in this Agreement at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter by giving not less than one (1) year's prior notice thereof, in writing, to the other Parties.
input.rationale: Paragraph 18.1 is the renewal analogue: the Agreement continues in operation indefinitely after the 25-year Initial Period, and the only unilateral exit for us as a Party is one (1) year's prior written notice. A 365-day exit window is well beyond the 60-day fallback ceiling and sits in walk-away territory (notice windows longer than 90 days), so the continuation mechanic fails the fallback on a material term. Paragraphs 18.2-18.3 (unanimous/two-thirds decommissioning votes) do not provide a shorter individual exit. There is no renewal price-uplift mechanic anywhere in Paragraph 18 (cost sharing is by actual Capital/O&M Costs under Schedule B), so the price-cap element is not engaged. Our redline makes the single shortest change: 60 days' prior notice in place of one year, leaving the balance of 18.1 and the downstream realization-of-assets provisions untouched.

proposal.summary: Shorten the exit notice for continuation after the Initial Period from one year to 60 days
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement continues in force after the 25-year Initial Period and a Party can only exit on one year's notice, which is far outside our maximum non-renewal window. We have shortened that notice to sixty (60) days, which is our fallback position; there is no renewal price uplift to cap.

ops.oldText: by giving not less than one (1) year's prior notice thereof, in writing, to the other Parties
ops.newText: by giving not less than sixty (60) days' prior notice thereof, in writing, to the other Parties

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: This Agreement shall become effective on the date and year first above written and shall continue in operation for at least an initial period of twenty-five (25) years following the RFS Date (hereinafter referred to as "initial Period") and shall be terminable thereafter by agreement of the Parties.
